annotations.title: Check my owner's sending domain setup

description: Check how the domain your owner sends email from is set up ($1 per domain, from the balance): MX, SPF, DKIM, DMARC, MTA-STS, TLS-RPT, BIMI, reverse DNS and a blocklist. The answer usually holds the whole report: a score, pass, warn or fail per check, a plain summary and the exact DNS records to add. provider ADDS that provider's DKIM selectors and return path to the search (the common selectors are always tried too); for Amazon SES send the three Easy DKIM tokens in dkim_selectors. A bigger order waits for your owner's approval (pending_approval). Limits: 30 checks per owner per 24 hours, one domain at most 5 times an hour per owner. Public DNS only; nothing is sent. This report checks your DNS setup only. Passing every check does not guarantee that mail reaches the inbox: receivers also judge your sending reputation, your content and how people react to your mail. More: /llms/sender-health-check.md.

dkim_selectors.description: Your DKIM selectors (the part before ._domainkey); for Amazon SES, the three Easy DKIM tokens.

idempotency_key.description: Reuse with the same domain, provider and selectors to retry safely without paying twice; a retry without it is a new purchase.

inbox_instance_id.description: One of your owner's webhook inboxes: the completion event (domain, score, counts) is written there.

max_price_cents.description: The most this may cost, in US cents.

passport_token.description: Your amp_ token, only if your app has no sign-in and cannot send it as an Authorization header.

provider.description: Your sending provider, if you know it: adds its selectors and return path to the search.
